title: Structures of topoisomerase V in complex with DNA reveal unusual DNA binding mode and novel relaxation mechanism
one_liner_zh: 该文解析拓扑异构酶V与DNA复合物结构，揭示非典型DNA结合模式与松弛机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作结构研究，但非TF-DNA体系且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅对互作界面建模有参考价值。
abstract: Topoisomerase V is a unique topoisomerase that combines DNA repair and topoisomerase activities. The enzyme has an unusual arrangement, with a small topoisomerase domain followed by 12 tandem (HhH) 2 domains, which include three AP lyase repair domains. The unusual architecture of this enzyme bears no resemblance to any other known topoisomerase. Here we present structures of topoisomerase V in complex with DNA. The structures show that the (HhH) 2 domains wrap around the DNA and in this manner appear to act as a processivity factor. There is a conformational change in the protein to expose the topoisomerase active site. The DNA bends sharply to enter the active site, which melts the DNA and probably facilitates relaxation. The structures show a DNA binding mode not observed before and provide information on the way this unusual topoisomerase relaxes DNA.
abstract_zh: 拓扑异构酶V是一种独特的拓扑异构酶，结合了DNA修复和拓扑异构酶活性。该酶具有不寻常的结构排列，包含一个小的拓扑异构酶结构域，随后是12个串联的（HhH）2结构域，其中包括三个AP裂解酶修复结构域。这种酶的不寻常架构与任何其他已知的拓扑异构酶均无相似之处。在此，我们展示了拓扑异构酶V与DNA复合物的结构。这些结构表明，（HhH）2结构域环绕DNA，并以此方式似乎充当持续性因子。蛋白质发生构象变化以暴露拓扑异构酶活性位点。DNA急剧弯曲进入活性位点，这使DNA解链，并可能促进松弛。这些结构展示了一种此前未观察到的DNA结合模式，并提供了关于这种不寻常拓扑异构酶如何松弛DNA的信息。
